name: SuperCollider
notes: 2026-10-29: Documentation assessment only; no installation, fixture, adapter or third-party rights verified.

2026-11-24: Guide written from partial NRT evidence (skills/supercollider/SKILL.md); frame-count finding recorded as a gotcha.

evidence.result: Five scored sine notes (440, 330, 660, 880, 550 Hz; starts 0.25 to 3.25 s) via sclang -D and Score.recordNRT (scsynth -N, /Applications/SuperCollider.app/Contents/Resources/scsynth) to 48 kHz stereo int16 WAV. Onsets within 0.6 ms, durations within 0.9 ms, pitch within 0.01 cents, peaks within 0.0001 of amplitude. Output 192064 frames, not the predeclared 192000 (one 64-sample block past 4.0 s): that check fails. Two renders byte-identical.
evidence.scope: Fixture-reported: headless NRT render, scored sine notes, onset/pitch/rerun checks pass; frame count off by one block; macOS arm64, SuperCollider 3.14.1

summary: Audio synthesis and algorithmic composition platform with the sclang language and a separate audio server. Scripted workflows need explicit server, timing and rendering configuration.
use_when: Explore configurable audio generation with a separate server
avoid_when: Need only prerecorded audio analysis: librosa
license: GPL-3.0 (repository label); verify dependencies and extensions separately
